root_idea.summary: The root denotes the extension or spreading of something, whether in breadth or in another dimension.
root_idea.development: From physical spreading and extension develop meanings of spaciousness, abundance, an outstretched or generous hand, expanded capacity, and things laid out or spread.

senses.definition: To spread, stretch, extend, or expand something.
senses.usage_conditions: The basic physical meaning applies to objects, limbs, hands, and other things capable of being extended or spread.

senses.definition: To enlarge, increase, or make abundant the means of subsistence or provision.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the basic meaning, especially with رزق or comparable resources.

senses.definition: To stretch out the hand against someone in assault, violence, or hostile action.
senses.usage_conditions: The hand construction can denote killing, striking, or otherwise directing hostile force toward another person.

senses.definition: To extend the hand in spending; to spend or give liberally.
senses.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of expenditure or open-handed giving, especially in the construction involving the hand and spending.

senses.definition: Expanded excellence or ample capacity, especially in knowledge and understanding.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression concerning knowledge and body, the noun denotes an increase or superiority in capacity.
Used of an expanded or outstanding bodily constitution; the Quranic context concerns physical stature.

senses.definition: One who stretches, extends, or holds out something.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle may describe the literal extension of a limb or hand, or a thing held out or spread.

senses.definition: One who reaches out with the hands in supplication or seeking.
senses.usage_conditions: In the comparison involving the hands extended toward water, the construction represents seeking or supplication that does not attain its object.

senses.definition: One who seizes or exercises dominion over another by force.
senses.usage_conditions: The outstretched hands of the angels are interpreted as the exercise of absolute power over those in their grasp; the hostile hand construction may likewise imply assault.

senses.definition: Extension or spreading; in the Quranic hand construction, extending it fully in expenditure.
senses.usage_conditions: The occurrence is in a phrase warning against complete extension of the hand, with the figurative sense of unrestricted spending.

senses.definition: A spread-out expanse; the earth as laid out and spacious.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage presents the earth as an extended surface or expanse.

senses.definition: Outstretched in liberal giving; bountiful or generous.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression of two hands, the outstretching is figurative and denotes unrestricted generosity or liberality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take possession of, seize, or exercise control over something or someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of stretching the hand toward an object or person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand by extending or opening the hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the gesture of extending the hands in supplication or request.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lay open or disclose one's state, affair, or circumstances to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is an affair or personal condition that is figuratively spread out before someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To diffuse souls through bodies at the time of animation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing the distribution of life or souls through bodies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enlarge the liberty or freedom granted to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may also be reversed in effect, describing the enlargement and subsequent restriction of another's freedom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone cheerful or joyous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative sense is associated with the unwrinkling and brightening of the countenance in joy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To free someone from shyness or aversion and embolden him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction denotes making a person forward, confident, or presumptuously bold toward another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or judge one person to excel another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction in which superiority is conceived as an extension over someone else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be sufficiently wide or ample for people or for an occupant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a place or bed that affords adequate room.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accept or admit an excuse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak freely or without restraint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of being unconstrained in one's tongue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To converse or behave with another freely, cheerfully, and without reserve.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived Form III construction can imply friendly, smiling, or easy interaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel far and wide through a country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived Form V use associated with moving broadly through open regions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go out into gardens, green fields, or verdant places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized use is connected with land having sweet-smelling plants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become spread, spread out, expanded, or extended.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VII verb is used for something becoming extended over or upon a surface; of the day, it can mean to advance or grow longer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To expatiate or range freely in discourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of becoming extended in speech or treatment of a subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cheerful or open in countenance or heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative sense describes the removal of contraction associated with grief or reserve.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become free from shyness and behave openly or boldly toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may imply forwardness, boldness, or presumptuousness in interaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A post-classical intoxicating preparation made from hemp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or post-classical lexical use, distinct from the ordinary meanings of extension and spreading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Width, ampleness, length, increase, excess, or completeness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader nominal uses of expanded extent beyond the Quranic applications to knowledge and bodily stature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beauty and sleekness of bodily form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use describing a person or animal as fine and well-formed in body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide and large, specifically of an ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival specialization describing the breadth and size of the ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of carpets or other spread furnishings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derivative referring to a person associated with selling بُسُط.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad, even, spacious land or a spacious place; figuratively, an ample or plentiful state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can describe an expansive tract, a roomy place, or a condition of ample circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land in which sweet-smelling plants grow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use referring to verdant, fragrant country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized concrete noun distinct from the meanings of land and spread objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing spread out, especially a carpet or floor covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may refer generally to anything laid out and, conventionally, to a carpet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leaves of the samur tree spread upon cloth after the tree is beaten.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized technical sense referring to the fallen leaves collected on a spread cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A figurative reference to hastening to cut short one's speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Appears in the idiom of hastening to fold or roll up one's spread carpet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Spread widely or continuously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of rain falling broadly and successively over the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall or extended in body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of bodily height, distinct from the noun بَسْطَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bright and unwrinkled in countenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a face showing joy or cheerfulness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Liberal, bountiful, or extensive in beneficence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes generous expenditure or giving through the figurative breadth of the hands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Free or unconstrained in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to one who is unrestricted in the use of the tongue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named metre of Arabic verse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical prosodic term, named with reference to the extension of its prosodic elements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Simple or uncompounded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A philosophical and technical use, not a direct physical meaning of extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A simple element.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A philosophical technical term; its plural is used for simple elements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The one who amplifies or makes plentiful the means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A divine epithet expressing the granting of provision through liberality and mercy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The one who diffuses souls through bodies when they are animated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A divine epithet based on the figurative extension of life through bodies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distant from the herbage or pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use describing water located away from grazing land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Far or long, especially of a journey or stage of travel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression can describe a difficult journey or a stage involving a long distance to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure consisting of a man's stature and an arm's length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized measurement used of the depth to which a well is dug.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Width or extent; an open area or expanse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun describing the extent available in a region or place.
